variant_semantics.R: rated: network copies carry rated capacity (spec section 3 item 3); the section 3 lower-bound construction
variant_semantics.A: available: network copies keep the certified available capacity; an ATTRIBUTION DIAGNOSTIC, NOT a lower bound of production (spec section 11 D-1). The Pyomo objective name d0_lb_objective is the builder's export convention and does not make A a bound.
variant_semantics.C: calendar-only available energy (spec section 11 D-2): NOT built in this run (not in the T0.1b order)

convention: gross_operational_cost (settlement-EXCLUDED): per block w_b * [objective_function_rule(b) - contracted settlement_b - voltage pin_b], w_b = _get_admm_block_weight; the ESSO contributes 0 (gross excludes it); salvage NOT subtracted (gross, not net)

sum_over_groups.note: the relaxed objective evaluated at the certified (and the rank-1 mapped) point: an IDENTITY check of the objective construction, not a bound value (no relaxation is solved here)
